# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(haven)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "HRS", "Phenotype")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")

stopifnot(dir.exists(hrs_dir))

if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Define Functions

## Load Data

```{r func_load}
load_hcap_merge_data <- function(hrs_dir, data_dir) {
  hsub <- haven::read_sas(
    file.path(hrs_dir, "HCAP", "HC16summary", "hc16hp_f.sas7bdat")
  )
  names(hsub) <- toupper(names(hsub))

  list(
    hsub = hsub,
    hc16 = readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "hc16_stats.RDS")),
    hc22 = readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "hc22_stats.RDS"))
  )
}
```

## Prepare Wave Scores

```{r func_prepare}
assert_unique_id <- function(data, label) {
  duplicate_ids <- data %>%
    dplyr::count(.data$HHID, .data$PN, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$n > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicate_ids) > 0) {
    stop(label, " has duplicated HHID/PN combinations.")
  }

  invisible(data)
}

make_wave_output <- function(processed_wave, wave) {
  processed_wave$subject_scores %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      SUT_MEM_COUNT = n_memory_tasks,
      SUT_MEM_CERAD3_COUNT = n_cerad_tasks,
      OSHEA_MEM_COUNT = n_oshea_items
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(
      ~paste0(.x, "_", wave),
      -dplyr::all_of(c("HHID", "PN"))
    )
}

get_wave_overlap_audit <- function(hc16_scores, hc22_scores) {
  ids16 <- hc16_scores %>% dplyr::select("HHID", "PN")
  ids22 <- hc22_scores %>% dplyr::select("HHID", "PN")

  tibble::tibble(
    group = c("HC16", "HC22", "both waves", "HC16 only", "HC22 only"),
    n_subjects = c(
      nrow(ids16),
      nrow(ids22),
      nrow(dplyr::inner_join(ids16, ids22, by = c("HHID", "PN"))),
      nrow(dplyr::anti_join(ids16, ids22, by = c("HHID", "PN"))),
      nrow(dplyr::anti_join(ids22, ids16, by = c("HHID", "PN")))
    )
  )
}

get_hc16_classification <- function(hc16) {
  hc16$hcap %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      HHID = .data$HHID,
      PN = .data$PN,
      HCAP_DIAGNOSIS_EAP = .data$VS1HCAPDX_EAP,
      MEMORY_IMPAIRMENT_EAP = .data$VS2MEMIMP_EAP
    )
}
```

## Merge Wave Scores

```{r func_merge}
# Join two tables that each have one row per HHID/PN
join_by_subject <- function(x, y, join = dplyr::left_join) {
  join(
    x,
    y,
    by = c("HHID", "PN"),
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )
}

merge_wave_scores <- function(
    hc16_scores, hc22_scores, hc16_classification, hsub
) {
  join_by_subject(hc16_scores, hc22_scores, join = dplyr::full_join) %>%
    join_by_subject(hc16_classification) %>%
    join_by_subject(
      hsub %>% dplyr::select("HHID", "PN", "VS4MEM_EAP", "VS4MEM_PV")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      SUTIN_CERAD_BOTH_WAVES = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$SUT_MEM_CERAD3_COUNT_16 == 3 &
          .data$SUT_MEM_CERAD3_COUNT_22 == 3,
        FALSE
      ),
      SUTIN_ALL8_BOTH_WAVES = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$SUT_MEM_COUNT_16 == 8 & .data$SUT_MEM_COUNT_22 == 8,
        FALSE
      ),
      SUT_MEM_ALL8_BOTH_16 = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$SUTIN_ALL8_BOTH_WAVES,
        .data$SUT_MEM_ALL8_16,
        NA_real_
      ),
      SUT_MEM_ALL8_BOTH_22 = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$SUTIN_ALL8_BOTH_WAVES,
        .data$SUT_MEM_ALL8_22,
        NA_real_
      ),
      OSHEA_ALL6_BOTH_WAVES = dplyr::coalesce(
        .data$OSHEA_MEM_COUNT_16 == 6 & .data$OSHEA_MEM_COUNT_22 == 6,
        FALSE
      ),
      OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_BOTH_16 = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$OSHEA_ALL6_BOTH_WAVES,
        .data$OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_16,
        NA_real_
      ),
      OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_BOTH_22 = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$OSHEA_ALL6_BOTH_WAVES,
        .data$OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_22,
        NA_real_
      )
    )
}
```

## Validate and Summarize Scores

```{r func_validate}
validate_interview_dates <- function(merge_df) {
  stopifnot(
    all(merge_df$INTERVIEW_MONTH_16 %in% c(1:12, NA)),
    all(merge_df$INTERVIEW_MONTH_22 %in% c(1:12, NA)),
    all(merge_df$INTERVIEW_YEAR_16 %in% c(2016:2017, NA)),
    all(merge_df$INTERVIEW_YEAR_22 %in% c(2022:2023, NA))
  )

  invisible(merge_df)
}

correlation_summary <- function(x, y, comparison) {
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
  x_used <- x[keep]
  y_used <- y[keep]

  if (
    length(x_used) < 3 ||
    stats::sd(x_used) == 0 ||
    stats::sd(y_used) == 0
  ) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      comparison = comparison,
      n_complete = length(x_used),
      pearson_r = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  test <- stats::cor.test(x_used, y_used, method = "pearson")

  tibble::tibble(
    comparison = comparison,
    n_complete = length(x_used),
    pearson_r = unname(test$estimate),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}

get_memory_correlation_summary <- function(merge_df) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    correlation_summary(
      merge_df$SUT_MEM_16,
      merge_df$VS4MEM_EAP,
      "Sutin vs EAP"
    ),
    correlation_summary(
      merge_df$OSHEA_MEM_16,
      merge_df$VS4MEM_EAP,
      "O'Shea vs EAP"
    ),
    correlation_summary(
      merge_df$SUT_MEM_16,
      merge_df$OSHEA_MEM_16,
      "Sutin vs O'Shea"
    ),
    correlation_summary(
      merge_df$SUT_MEM_ALL8_BOTH_16,
      merge_df$SUT_MEM_ALL8_BOTH_22,
      "Sutin all-8: HC16 vs HC22"
    ),
    correlation_summary(
      merge_df$OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_BOTH_16,
      merge_df$OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_BOTH_22,
      "O'Shea all-6: HC16 vs HC22"
    )
  )
}

get_score_distribution_summary <- function(merge_df, hc16_count, hc22_count) {
  score_vars <- c(
    "SUT_MEM_16",
    "SUT_MEM_22",
    "SUT_MEM_CERAD3_16",
    "SUT_MEM_CERAD3_22",
    "SUT_MEM_ALL8_BOTH_16",
    "SUT_MEM_ALL8_BOTH_22",
    "OSHEA_MEM_16",
    "OSHEA_MEM_22",
    "OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_BOTH_16",
    "OSHEA_MEM_ALL6_BOTH_22"
  )
  size_df <- data.frame(
    score = score_vars
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      wave = stringr::str_split_i(.data$score, pattern = "_", i = -1)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      data.frame(wave = c("16", "22"), size = c(hc16_count, hc22_count)),
      by = "wave"
    )

  stat_df <- merge_df %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(score_vars),
        list(
          n = ~sum(!is.na(.x)),
          missing = ~sum(is.na(.x)),
          mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          sd = ~stats::sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      dplyr::everything(),
      names_to = c("score", ".value"),
      names_pattern = "^(.*)_(n|missing|mean|sd)$"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(size_df, by = "score") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      not_recorded = .data$size - .data$n,
      not_in_wave = .data$missing - .data$not_recorded
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "n",
      "missing",
      "not_recorded",
      "not_in_wave",
      "mean",
      "sd"
    )

  stat_df
}
```

## Save Results

```{r func_save}
save_hcap_memory_scores <- function(merge_df, data_dir) {
  write.csv(
    merge_df,
    file = file.path(data_dir, "hcap_memory_scores_by_subject.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Wrapper Function

```{r func_wrapper}
process_hcap_merge <- function(hcap_data) {
  hc16_scores <- make_wave_output(hcap_data$hc16, "16")
  hc22_scores <- make_wave_output(hcap_data$hc22, "22")

  assert_unique_id(hc16_scores, "HC16 score data")
  assert_unique_id(hc22_scores, "HC22 score data")
  assert_unique_id(hcap_data$hsub, "HC16 summary data")

  merge_audit <- get_wave_overlap_audit(hc16_scores, hc22_scores)

  hc16_classification <- get_hc16_classification(hcap_data$hc16)
  assert_unique_id(hc16_classification, "HC16 classification data")

  merge_df <- merge_wave_scores(
    hc16_scores,
    hc22_scores,
    hc16_classification,
    hcap_data$hsub
  )

  # Add back in columns that were dropped due to a rewrite
  params_df <- hcap_data$hc16$hcap %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "HHID", "PN", "R1IWYEAR", "R1IWMONTH", "VS1HCAPDX_EAP", "VS2MEMIMP_EAP"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::full_join(
      hcap_data$hc22$hcap %>%
        dplyr::select("HHID", "PN", "R2IWYEAR", "R2IWMONTH"),
      by = c("HHID", "PN"),
      na_matches = "never"
    )

  merge_df <- merge_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      params_df,
      by = c("HHID", "PN"),
      na_matches = "never"
    )

  list(
    merge_df = merge_df,
    merge_audit = merge_audit
  )
}
```

# Analysis

## Load Data

```{r load}
hcap_data <- load_hcap_merge_data(hrs_dir, data_dir)
```

## Merge

```{r merge}
merge_results <- process_hcap_merge(hcap_data)
merge_df <- merge_results$merge_df
merge_results$merge_audit
```

## Check Year Parameters

```{r check_year}
validate_interview_dates(merge_df)
```

# Compare Memory

```{r validation}
correlation_results <- get_memory_correlation_summary(merge_df)
correlation_results

score_distribution_summary <- get_score_distribution_summary(
  merge_df,
  hc16_count = nrow(hcap_data$hc16$hcap),
  hc22_count = nrow(hcap_data$hc22$hcap)
)
score_distribution_summary
```

# Save

The subject-level file has one row per unique `HHID`/`PN` observed in either
wave. For each wave it includes the raw task values, the standardized task
components used in the composites, component counts, primary scores, and
sensitivity scores. The `*_BOTH_16` and `*_BOTH_22` scores are populated only
for participants who satisfy the strict all-task requirement in both waves.

```{r save}
save_hcap_memory_scores(merge_df, data_dir)
```
